page_title: NIC 2-0 REN | Nice v Rennes 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+1' That's the end of the game for Nemanja Matic, who is replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Amine Gouiri will be replaced by Guela Doue (Rennes).
87' 2 - 0 Steve Mandanda (Rennes) has scored a goal! Unfortunately for him and his teammates it's an own goal.
87' Sofiane Diop (Nice) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the crossbar!
87' It seems like Sofiane Diop (Nice) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
85' Warmed Omari (Rennes) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
83' Shots on target – 3:4.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Morgan Sanson (Nice) replaces Khephren Thuram.
80' Terem Moffi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sofiane Diop (Nice).
80' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Romain Perraud (Nice) replaces Jeremie Boga.
79' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) whips the ball into the box and Arnaud Kalimuendo takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) for Enzo Le Fee.
77' Great ball in from Nemanja Matic. Amine Gouiri (Rennes) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
77' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
75' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) has to leave the pitch!
75' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice)! Let's see what he decides.
74' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
71' Dangerous play by Amine Gouiri (Rennes). Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Nice, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
70' Desire Doue (Rennes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
68' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
66' Desire Doue (Rennes) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Marcin Bulka.
65' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
63' The substitution is prepared. Evann Guessand (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gaetan Laborde.
62' Hicham Boudaoui plays a beautiful lofted pass to Jeremie Boga (Nice), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
60' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post.
60' Melvin Bard (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
59' It's time for a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) comes on in place of Ludovic Blas.
59' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Martin Terrier and he is replaced by Desire Doue (Rennes).
58' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
58' Jeremie Boga (Nice) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
57' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Nice.
55' The corner from Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is intercepted by Steve Mandanda.

54' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.
53' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
52' Looks like Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
51' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
47' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Steve Mandanda, who pulls off a decent save!
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A wild pass somehow finds Terem Moffi (Nice) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Hicham Boudaoui plays it into the box, and Jeremie Boga (Nice) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
43' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. That's a free kick to Rennes.
42' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
42' Khephren Thuram (Nice) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
41' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gets on the end of a cross from Khephren Thuram, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the right post.
37' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.

36' Warmed Omari (Rennes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Nice will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

35' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Clement Turpin with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Rennes in a dangerous position.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.

33' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Terem Moffi (Nice) was too forceful with his tackle and Clement Turpin interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Rennes have a free kick.
29' Jeremie Boga (Nice) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
26' Dante (Nice) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
26' Jeremie Boga (Nice) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
25' Jeremie Boga (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Nice have a corner.
25' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Marcin Bulka makes a comfortable save.
23' Nice concede a free kick following a bad challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Rennes.
22' Good chance! Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
19' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
18' Khephren Thuram (Nice) is able to continue to play.
17' Khephren Thuram (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' Jeremie Boga plays a lovely pass into Hicham Boudaoui (Nice), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.
10' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but Steve Mandanda comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

5' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
5' Khephren Thuram (Nice) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
3' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
2' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Clement Turpin.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.

Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
